partition: numeric batch modulo6=1; concurrent batches460–477 excluded
scope: Complete Japanese premise and sentence/task review against all12 target sets. Metadata/native/device approval excluded.
reviewCriteria: Cart wheel and own bag cord: stop forcing, unload goods, release without cutting, inspect personal bag, leave cart with staff.
Practice/submission printouts: identify original filenames and signature field; learner alone checks private contents; take draft home for disposal.
Old application form: date alone or matching appearance does not establish validity; do not submit before staff comparison.
Ambiguous handwritten address: obtain recipient written confirmation, do not infer from postcode, retain parcel until corrected.
Unverified bank call: official contact route, withheld account number, factual notes without guessing or claiming successful authentication.
Sketching obstruction: clear path, stop insisting on same view, move friend bag with owner, check walking width.
Dinosaur scale model versus actual size and estimated length: retain estimate uncertainty, defer research details to exhibit staff.
Temple bell recording: permission pending, protect nearby conversations, stay in permitted visitor area, keep phone put away.
Lost umbrella versus theft: observed similarities do not prove identity or theft; record time and red-thread feature without confrontation.
Medicine proxy purchase: missing name and concurrent medicine details; consult pharmacist, decline guess purchase, father participates when contacting service.
Companion goshuin book: consent before entry; request only own book and put companion book away after refusal.
Food factory torn glove: preserve fragment evidence, freeze potentially affected products, use work records instead of narrowing by memory.
Theme park toilet queue: two leave and two remain; do not assume re-entry rights; meet at exit if joint ride not possible.
Health-check milk drink: report time and cup amount, await medical decision; no inference that test or schedule is already cancelled.
Furniture: fitting room does not prove stair-route clearance; measure turns and check building usage rules without removing communal handrails.
Udon spill: mark location before leaving, staff handle cleaning, keep passage clear and temporary tray place explicit.
Izakaya: no alcohol even for toast or group additions; hot tea stays learner choice.
Precision measurement: decimal-point error before disposition, unassessed storage, read-back and prescribed traceable record correction.
Eye appointment: disclose changed vision and onset without diagnosing; left/right not invented when absent in source.
Left-handed craft grip: no blind mirror reversal; learner requests instructor observe grip; adjust elbow spacing before practice.

sourceIssues.issue: Existing gendered first-person forms in some target languages remain profile-dependent; no user gender policy was invented.

Japanese 全員で乗らず leaves scope unclear: nobody rides versus not riding as entire family. Targets now preserve not whole-family joint ride; source needs explicit author decision before full semantic acceptance.
Japanese requests left/right reporting but says only 片方 without specifying actual side. Targets preserve unspecified one eye; no left/right invented.

つゆ in self-service udon context may be broth or dipping sauce; Japanese premise does not specify serving style. Existing translations differ at this granularity; do not certify culinary term consistency until source clarification.
